review.shorterRoute: The actual finite elliptic-fiber consumer uses ofJ over K(t) and a finite Galois torsion field. Descent to an algebraic extension of the j field suffices for that exact consumer. Original-coordinate separability and native fixed-root descent avoid arbitrary coefficient-curve transport. Normalized-embedding conjugacy proves exhaustion without repeating a torsion/sign-class count. The compiling but incidental variable-change Galois modules 1940-1942 are deferred.
assumptionsToDischarge: Original-coordinate separability derives from its finite degree and simple Laurent pole.
Galois covariance fixes every embedding value attached to a rational point.
Separable fixed-root descent supplies the embedding in the actual torsion field.
Native full-torsion lifting supplies an exact-order point from the actual N-squared count.
Normality and generation of the base field by j make all normalized embeddings conjugate and hence prove exhaustion.
review.remaining: Apply the chart to the actual finite Galois torsion-reduction data, prove finite elliptic place-fiber bounds and reverse genus, then continue original association and higher continuation. Level-one chart special cases remain to be handled if the exact consumer needs them. Acceptance16/20; DUB17--20 OPEN.
